summary: Septerna filed an 8-K to announce the appointment of Rajiv Patni, M.D., as Chief Medical Officer, effective August 24, 2026. The press release, furnished as Exhibit 99.1, highlights Dr. Patni's 25+ years in biopharmaceutical R&D. This is a routine executive appointment, not a forced departure or strategic event. Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclose the appointment and provide the press release. No deal terms, no board recommendation, no takeover or capital structure changes. Watch for future clinical pipeline developments, but no special-situation angle applies.
